facts.fact: The vendor's Free plan is priced at $0 per month.
The vendor's Free plan limits users to 7 messages per day.
The vendor's Plus plan is listed at a price range of $30 to $90 per user per month.
The vendor's Plus plan includes $30 of monthly credits per user.
facts.quote: $30 of included monthly credits per user

facts.fact: The vendor's Plus plan includes $2 of free daily credits on login per user.
facts.quote: $2 of free daily credits on login per user

facts.fact: The vendor's Business plan is priced at $100 per user per month.
The vendor's Business plan includes training opt-out by default.
The vendor's Enterprise plan is offered at custom pricing and lists SAML SSO and role-based access control.
The vendor states that Enterprise customer data is never used for training.
facts.quote: Your data is never used for training

facts.fact: The vendor states that all listed prices are in USD and exclude VAT, GST, and other applicable taxes.
